photo.alt: Iceland from orbit on a cloud-free day
photo.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2020, European Space Agency, via Wikimedia Commons

facts: An island country on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, about 103,000 km2
worth_knowing: The interior is a volcanic plateau with sand and lava fields, mountains and glaciers, and many glacial rivers flow to the sea through the lowlands.
